title: TenantMembershipSnapshot
description: Portable, versioned, authoritative list of the identities that are members of one tenant, with opaque role bindings (fabric#57). It carries data only: not credentials, not the transport that delivers it, and not product role policy. A consumer applies it independently of how the snapshot was authenticated.

schemaVersion.description: Contract version. A consumer rejects every value it does not know (fail closed).

sequence.description: Monotonic revision within the tenant. A consumer never accepts a lower sequence than it has applied; an equal sequence is accepted only when the content is identical.

validUntil.description: Instant at which the snapshot stops conferring membership. Must be later than issuedAt.

members.description: The complete membership. Absence from this list means the identity is not a member; there is no per-member disabled flag.

issuer.description: Identity provider issuer (the OIDC 'iss'). Compared exactly.

subject.description: Stable subject within that issuer (the OIDC 'sub'). Compared exactly; never an email.

roles.description: Opaque role names bound to this member. Their meaning is product policy, not part of this contract.
